verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser runs AI browser agents (HyperAgent and hosted agents), so letting users plug external MCP servers into those agents is a fair question. The evidence only documents Hyperbrowser acting as an MCP server that exposes scraping, extraction and crawling tools to other AI models. Nothing shows its agents can connect to or consume third-party MCP servers, and that server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
